info.name: Materials Project Defect Tasks Materials Alloys API

params.name: material_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of material_ids to query on

params.name: formulae
params.description: Comma-separated list of end-point formulas to query.

params.name: _page
params.description: Page number to request (takes precedent over _limit and _skip).

params.name: _per_page
params.description: Number of entries to show per page (takes precedent over _limit and _skip). Limited to 1000.

params.name: _skip
params.description: Number of entries to skip in the search.

params.name: _limit
params.description: Max number of entries to return in a single query. Limited to 1000.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Fields to project from AlloyPairDoc as a list of comma separated strings.                    Fields include: `builder_meta` `alloy_pair` `pair_id`
